data.name: Intikhaabat
data.gender_notes: Intikhaabat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The state of waiting, expectation, and anticipation. It implies a sense of excitement and eagerness for something to happen, often referring to the arrival of a new baby or the fulfillment of a promise. The name Intikhaabat carries the meaning “Awaiting, anticipation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Intikhaabat usually hope their child will grow to embody awaiting, anticipation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine promise and the belief in the infinite wisdom and benevolence of Allah. It can also symbolize the patience and faith required during times of waiting and the understanding that Allah's timing is perfect.
data.etymology: Intikhaabat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awaiting, anticipation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Intikhaabat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: انتخابات
in_arabic.long_meaning: انتخابات هي كلمة تعني الاختيار أو الانتخاب بين الأشياء، وقد وردت في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيُشَرِّعُ لَهُمُ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ أَبَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِذْ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ لَهُمُ اخْتَارُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ أَمُ تَخْتَرُونَ لِيَ غَيْرَهُ' (البقرة: 124). وتدل الكلمة على عملية الاختيار والانتخاب بين الأشياء، وتشير إلى أهمية اتخاذ القرارات الصائبة في الحياة.

in_urdu.name: انتخابات
in_urdu.long_meaning: انتخابات کا مطلب ہے انتخاب کرنا یا چننا۔ یہ لفظ عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں بھی کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: 'وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَنْ يَخْتَرِكَ فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ فَلْيَأْتِ بِالْحُجَّةِ' (آل عمران: 80)। یہ لفظ انتخاب اور اختیار کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इन्तिखाबात
in_hindi.long_meaning: इन्तिखाबात का अर्थ है चुनाव या चयन करना। यह शब्द अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी किया जाता है। यह शब्द कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि सूरा आলে इमरान में: 'और न किसी مؤمن के लिए उचित है कि वह (अपने दिल से) आपको चुन ले'। यह शब्द चयन और विकल्प की महत्ता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: انتخاباټ
in_pashto.long_meaning: انتخاباټ د غوره کولو یا ټاکلو معنی لري. دا کلمه د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوې ده او د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کړاوونو کې کارول کیږي. دا کلمه په قرآن کریم کې هم راغلې ده، لکه څنګه چې د آل عمران سوره کې: 'او هیڅ مؤمنه لپاره نه ده روا چې تاسو ته ځان وټاکي'. دا کلمه د ټاکلو او غوره کولو اهمیت ښیي.

in_english.name: Intikhaabat
in_english.long_meaning: Intikhaabat is derived from Arabic roots and means 'selection' or 'election'. It appears in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of making choices. Historically, it signifies the act of choosing or electing, reflecting on personal and communal decision-making in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Intikhaabat" holds a deep cultural significance in the Islamic community, often used to denote the pregnant woman's emotional state during the final stages of her pregnancy. The name evokes a sense of hopefulness, joy, and excitement as the family eagerly awaits the arrival of the newborn child.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, this name encourages the expectant mother to stay patient and faithful throughout the final stages of her pregnancy. It reminds her of the view of pregnancy as a blessed event, a gift from Allah, and the incoming child as a blessing from Him. Intikhaabat also signifies the belief that all things, including the arrival of a child, are in Allah's divine plan and perfect timing. Ultimately, this name fosters an atmosphere of expectation, hope, and faith, reflecting the importance of embracing the unknown and trusting in Allah's guidance.
